title: Founder & Principal architect
titleZh: 创始人 / 主创建筑师
note: Founded the studio after four years inside a top-tier institute. DoraWolf Studio is an independent practice working at the intersection of education, infrastructure, and civic buildings. The studio reads each site — its topography, climate, and public edges — before any form is committed, then builds with a small kit of computational tools (Sketchup, Grasshopper, Rhino, Ladybug) used well rather than widely.
noteZh: 在大型设计院四年训练后离开,创立独立工作室。DoraWolf 工作室聚焦于教育建筑、基础设施与公共建筑的交叉地带。每个方案都从读地形、读气候、读城市边界开始,再以一套小而精的计算工具(Sketchup、Grasshopper、Rhino、Ladybug)推进至落地。

title: Architectural designer
org: China Architecture Design & Research Group · Wuhan studio
orgZh: 中信建筑设计研究总院
note: Top-60 Chinese engineering design enterprise; the foreign-aid engineering institute under the Ministry of Commerce. Schematic and competition work across education, infrastructure, and civic typologies — the projects on the case-study list above were largely conceived during these four years and now form the studio's founding portfolio.
noteZh: 中国工程设计企业 60 强,商务部援外工程设计定点院。在此完成的方案与竞赛覆盖教育、基础设施与公共建筑领域——这些项目随后构成了 DoraWolf 工作室的创业资产。
